# Priyanka Kamath

> Priyanka Kamath is a Software Development Manager III at Amazon in Vancouver,
> British Columbia. She leads engineering teams across regulatory and compliance
> software, AI-native compensation systems, cloud security patching, and
> large-scale data platforms.

## Facts

- Current role: Software Development Manager III, Amazon, Vancouver, BC (since June 2025)
- Team: 11 engineers on the Amazon & AWS Compensation product, serving 400K+ employees
- Prior employers: Amazon (Seattle, Arlington, Vancouver), Flexport, Wipro Technologies
- Education: M.S. Computer Science, University at Buffalo (SUNY), 2015–2017; B.E. Electrical & Electronics Engineering, NMAM Institute of Technology, 2009–2013
- Contact: kamathp@amazon.com · https://www.linkedin.com/in/priyankakh/

## Selected results

- Delivered the regulatory software required to launch Amazon.pl, Amazon.nl, Amazon.se, and AWS Marketplace across Europe.
- Replaced manual anti-money-laundering SQL rule-writing with machine learning models, removing $1.05M in annual cost.
- Led the AWS Systems Manager patching team (12 engineers) for EC2 and hybrid instances, serving 5MM+ customers.
- Shipped Conversation Coach and Compensation Explainability AI features for the 2026 Annual Compensation cycle.
- Led a 25-person organization covering regulatory reporting, denied party and PEP screening, and suspicious activity monitoring across Amazon Stores, AWS Marketplace, and Amazon Gift Cards.
- Built the KPIs and UX integrations behind Amazon Brand Registry's growth to ~130,000 brands and $3B+ in sales.
- Brought Amazon Stores' regulatory services into GDPR and CCPA compliance, avoiding an estimated $5–25M in fines.
